description: This file defines the `Root` class within the PhpSpreadsheet library for creating and managing the root entry of an OLE container. It contains methods for saving the entire OLE structure, calculating sizes, and managing block data, specifically for a class that extends `PPS` used for creating Root PPS entries of OLE compound documents.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: A class for creating and saving the root storage entry of an OLE container, extending the PPS class to handle root-specific structures and data management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Root object, setting timestamps and child entries, and calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entire OLE container structure to the provided file handle, including headers, big data, PPS entries, and small data.

methods.name: calcSize
methods.description: Calculates the size metrics for small and big block storage of PPS data, returning counts used for header and block allocations.

methods.name: adjust2
methods.description: Helper function to calculate the appropriate block size exponent, used for setting block sizes.

methods.name: saveHeader
methods.description: Writes the OLE compound document header to the file, including block counts and directory structure information.

methods.name: saveBigData
methods.description: Writes large PPS data to the output stream, for data exceeding small block size.

methods.name: makeSmallData
methods.description: Generates a contiguous string of small PPS data and constructs the small block data chain allocation table.

methods.name: savePps
methods.description: Serializes each PPS object’s WK (well-known name) data to the output file, padding as necessary.

methods.name: saveBbd
methods.description: Creates the Block Depot (Big Block Depot) structure, managing block chain links for directory entries.
